Name: Star Furnace
Author: jukie1
Description:
Adds A Star furnace that doesn't require coal, only needs 1 ore per bar, and is very fast!

Adds star fragments that spawn in the forest below the farm at night!
[s]
[/s]Made with all the star fragments from this mod!

Now Available in Heavy Furnace!

Star fragments spawn in the secret woods after 8pm, and the star drop sound effect will play!



[size=3]Using the star furnace you can make a star bar if you have all of the star fragments in your inventory and are holding a prismatic shard! (the star bar sells for 8000 gold)

[/size][center]
[size=6][b][i]Guide
[/i][/b][/size]Maintained by Jukie1
Written by Jukie1's Sister


[size=5]Star Fragments[/size]

Star Fragments spawn after 9 pm in Cindersap Forest
(A player must be present to allow spawns)

Star fragment with a seasonal identifier are found during their respected seasons
(with the exception of the Nebula and solar fragments)

Nebula Fragments can be found during the winter
Solar fragments can be found during the summer

[size=5]Recipes[/size]
[size=3](Normal star furnace)
[/size](Every Vanilla Bar)
To create a vanilla bar it costs 1 ore (of the bar you want to make) per bar (It requires no fuel)
Output amount: 1 bar

(Nova Star Bar)
To create a Nova Star bar you need to interact with the furnace whilst holding a prismatic shard (It requires every star fragment as fuel)
Output amount: 1 bar

[size=3](Heavy Star Furnace)[/size]
(Every Vanilla Bar except Radioactive Bars)
To create a vanilla bar it costs 1 ore (of the bar you want to make) per craft (It requires no fuel)
Output amount: 2 - 3 bars


To create a radioactive bar, it costs 1 radioactive ore per craft (It requires no fuel)
Output amount: 2 - 4

(Nova Star Bar)
To create a Nova Star bar you need to interact with the furnace whilst holding a prismatic shard (It requires every star fragment as fuel)
Output amount: 1 - 2 bars[/center]
